title: Detailed teapot
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- shadow/glow under pot -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="86" rx="32" ry="5" fill="#1a2a4a"/>
  
  <!-- saucer -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="82" rx="30" ry="6" fill="#c0392b"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="80" rx="30" ry="6" fill="#e74c3c"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="80" rx="22" ry="4" fill="#c0392b"/>
  
  <!-- handle (behind body) -->
  <path d="M72 40 Q92 40 92 58 Q92 74 72 74" fill="none" stroke="#d4880f" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M72 40 Q88 40 88 58 Q88 72 72 72" fill="none" stroke="#f1c40f" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- spout -->
  <path d="M28 48 Q10 44 8 30 Q6 20 14 18" fill="none" stroke="#d4880f" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M28 48 Q12 44 10 31 Q9 23 15 21" fill="none" stroke="#f1c40f" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <ellipse cx="13" cy="20" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#f1c40f" transform="rotate(-30 13 20)"/>
  
  <!-- body -->
  <path d="M30 42 Q28 34 34 30 Q42 26 50 26 Q58 26 66 30 Q72 34 70 42 Q72 56 68 68 Q64 78 50 80 Q36 78 32 68 Q28 56 30 42 Z" fill="#e74c3c"/>
  <!-- body highlight -->
  <path d="M36 38 Q34 32 40 30 Q46 28 50 28 Q54 28 58 30 Q62 34 60 38 Q58 50 56 60 Q54 68 50 70 Q46 68 44 60 Q42 50 40 38 Z" fill="#f1948a" opacity="0.5"/>
  
  <!-- decorative band on body -->
  <path d="M31 56 Q50 60 69 56" fill="none" stroke="#f1c40f" stroke-width="3"/>
  <path d="M32 62 Q50 66 68 62" fill="none" stroke="#f1c40f" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- lid -->
  <path d="M32 32 Q50 22 68 32 Q50 28 32 32 Z" fill="#c0392b"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="30" rx="19" ry="6" fill="#e74c3c"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="30" rx="14" ry="4" fill="#c0392b" opacity="0.5"/>
  
  <!-- lid knob -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="24" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#f1c40f"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="22" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#f9e79f"/>
  
  <!-- spout opening highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="13" cy="19" rx="3" ry="1.5" fill="#f9e79f" transform="rotate(-30 13 19)"/>
  
  <!-- steam wisps -->
  <path d="M44 16 Q42 10 46 5" fill="none" stroke="#aed6f1" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7"/>
  <path d="M52 14 Q54 8 50 3" fill="none" stroke="#aed6f1" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7"/>
  <path d="M60 16 Q62 10 58 6" fill="none" stroke="#85c1e9" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.5"/>
</svg>
